score_form: the short-conv machine: the K15 composed machine (the K13 additive read under the K11B p3 per-channel gate stack) + GDN2's registered short depthwise convolution (kernel 4, bias-free, the silu NOT transplanted) on the payload path, born at the identity kernel [0,0,0,1] (the standard nn.Conv1d layout)

gate_a_conv.name: A-conv
gate_a_conv.note: the conv's own unit receipts at the registered channel count (256, kernel 4)

minus_zero_corner.note: the IEEE corner: -0.0 can flip to +0.0 through the zero taps' additions; counted here, invisible to every ==-based parity bar and to the loss

equivalence_to_nn_conv1d.note: the explicit tap sum IS the causal depthwise conv (nn.Conv1d(C,C,4,groups=C,bias=False) with left zero-padding, the fla ShortConvolution layout); cuDNN's accumulation order is the only difference

gate_a2.name: A2
gate_a2.note: the conv machine's birth receipts at the registered shape (batch 8, 2048 tokens, rank 128)

born_as_the_composed_machine.note: at the identity birth the conv'd payload IS the raw payload, so the composed kernel's every channel is the composed machine's own -- the machine is BORN AS THE COMPOSED MACHINE bit for bit (and hence as the K13 additive machine: the K15 receipt's own chain)

decisions_bit_identical_under_random_con.note: P2 trivially held: no conv value feeds op selection, the read weights or the key table -- the value state and the reads move as designed off the identity birth

gate_d.name: D
gate_d.note: the conv's own block-call cost per (layer, window) at the registered shape, vs the composed scan's own same-session launch -- stated, not estimated; the conv's cost is the mixer's, outside the scan's opaque op pair
